what_is_being_tested: Arm A (production uniform draw over the legal fiber at current_state_edits.py line 53) vs Arm B (the same draw re-weighted by a trained RingCore-V1 editing model, floored at 0.05 so every legal successor keeps positive probability). Identical parents, identical candidate lists, identical seeds, matched draw counts. Nothing but the draw weighting differs.

P1_primary_from_brief.claim: Under B, median QED of PROPOSED ENDPOINTS stays near its parent's QED rather than degrading, and does not collapse toward the 0.41 the scored population reached.
P1_primary_from_brief.interpretation_declared_up_front: The brief's 0.763 is the INITIALIZATION median. A single edit from a parent already at QED 0.41 cannot reach 0.763, so a literal 'median proposal QED == 0.763' is not attainable by any proposal law at this call site. The testable form is the one measured here: the CHANGE in QED from parent to proposed endpoint. Absolute medians are reported alongside so the raw comparison remains visible.
P1_primary_from_brief.falsified_if: B's mean per-edit dQED is not materially better than A's (difference within +/- 1 standard error).

P2_per_edit_gate.claim: Mean per-edit dQED under B moves materially toward 0 relative to A, and the percentage of edits LOSING QED falls below A's rate.
P2_per_edit_gate.why_this_is_sharper: It is attributable per edit and per family, and it does not confound the proposal law with parent quality the way a population median does.

P3_stratification_declared_now_not_post_.claim: Results are reported stratified by parent heavy-atom count.
P3_stratification_declared_now_not_post_.reason: The parent allocator correction measured that drawn parents are median 9-15 heavy atoms with 30-40 percent under 10, several of them degenerate 1-3 atom fragments. A chemistry prior cannot make a good drug out of a one-atom parent in one edit, so an unstratified aggregate cannot separate 'the prior does not work' from 'the parents are fragments'. Both readings are reported.

P4_diversity_trade.claim: B produces fewer distinct endpoints than A at matched draw counts, because a floored re-ranking concentrates mass.
P4_diversity_trade.acceptance: A diversity loss is acceptable only if reported as a number beside the chemistry gain. If B holds chemistry up but collapses distinct endpoints by more than half, that is a real trade and the owner decides, not this agent.
P4_diversity_trade.floor_rationale: floor=0.05 caps the most-favoured candidate at 20x the least, so the support is identical to A's and no legal successor is ever excluded.

P5_support_identity.claim: The set of endpoints REACHABLE under B is exactly the set reachable under A. The prior re-ranks; it never filters.
P5_support_identity.test: assert the ordered candidate list under B is a permutation of A's candidate list, on every call.

DECISIVE_NEGATIVE_IS_A_VALID_OUTCOME: If B does not hold chemistry up, that is reported plainly as the answer: the available checkpoint is too weak or mis-scoped for this path. No pass will be manufactured, and no threshold in this file will be relaxed after seeing a number.
cost_metric_declared: Load-independent work counters only (model forwards, candidates scored, candidates joined, successor executions, orders drawn). Wall clock is contaminated: other jobs run on this machine.

environment.note: The pinned production kernel HAS torch, so model inference and chemistry are both computed under the pinned kernel. No mixed-environment caveat applies.
